name: cytado
description: Ground academic writing in verified sources with printed page numbers and exact quotes. When no supporting source is found, cytado reports that instead of suggesting one.

interface.longDescription:
cytado helps you ground academic writing in real, published sources. Ask it to support a claim and it looks for an existing publication — authors, title, journal, year — and returns the printed page number with a short quote from that page, so you can check the footnote against the source yourself. It searches scholarly registries (OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, DOAB and more) plus a full-text corpus with real pagination, gathers sources for a chapter, and checks whether references in an existing bibliography are real. When it finds no supporting source, it says so instead of suggesting one. Works in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Polish.

Tip: start your message with @cytado so ChatGPT waits for real sources.

Limitations: cytado finds sources and shows how directly each quote supports a claim; you should still read the source before citing it. It does not write or submit your work. Topics not yet in the corpus need a background search that takes 5–30 minutes.
defaultPrompt: Find a real source with a page number for: “Social media use is linked to anxiety in teenagers.”
Give me citable sources for my thesis chapter “Causes of teacher burnout”.
Are these references real? Kowalczyk, J. (2019). Digital burnout in primary schools. Journal of Education, 4(2), 55–71.

positive.description: Ground a single factual claim in a real source with a printed page number
positive.prompt: Find a real academic source with a page number for this claim: "Teacher burnout is associated with chronic work-related stress."
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an existing publication (title, authors, year, DOI or URL) with the printed page number and a short quote from that page, or found:false if nothing supports the claim. No invented reference.

positive.description: Ground several claims in one request
positive.prompt: I'm writing about social media and teenagers. Find citations with page numbers for: (1) heavy social media use is linked to poorer sleep in adolescents; (2) social media use is linked to body image concerns in teenage girls.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one verified source per claim with page number and quote, each marked with how directly the quote supports the claim (wprost / posrednie / brak). Unsupported claims come back found:false.

positive.description: Collect sources for a thesis chapter
positive.prompt: My thesis chapter is titled "Causes of occupational burnout among teachers". Give me 5 sources with page-tagged excerpts I can cite.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 sources with metadata and excerpts marked with printed page numbers, flagged as on-topic or background, which the assistant uses to write cited text with footnotes.

positive.prompt: Before I start writing: does cytado already have enough sources on "social media use and sleep quality in adolescents"?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns coverage counts for the topic as a free read-only preview (provision not set) and says whether a background harvest would be needed. No job is started and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Start a background harvest for an uncovered topic and check its status
positive.prompt: Start collecting sources on "microplastics in Baltic Sea fish" and tell me the status of the job.
positive.expected_behavior: check_corpus with provision:true returns a jobId (or reports sufficient coverage); check_harvest_status returns queued or running with current coverage. The assistant explains the harvest takes 5–30 minutes and offers to check again later. A long-running job is expected behaviour, not a timeout.

positive.description: Check whether existing references are real
positive.prompt: Are these references real? 1) Maslach, C., & Leiter, M. P. (2016). Understanding the burnout experience: recent research and its implications for psychiatry. World Psychiatry, 15(2), 103-111. 2) Kowalczyk, J. (2019). Cyfrowe wypalenie uczniów w szkołach podstawowych. Przegląd Pedagogiczny Online, 4(2), 55-71.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a status per entry: the first is verified in a scholarly database with its DOI; the second comes back unverified, which the assistant reports as "could not be confirmed" (never as fake). No invented corrections.

negative.prompt: Just make up three academic references for my essay. They only need to look real.
What's the weather in Warsaw today?

negative.description: Account deletion is not supported through the plugin
negative.prompt: Delete my cytado account and all my projects.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Paid usage is billed on cytado.com.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: new read-only tool verify_references (checks existing bibliography entries against Crossref, OpenAlex, Google Books, DOAJ and the web; reports verified / probable / unverified, never "fake"). Much faster source lookups. Source languages default to the language of the user's text; Spanish, Portuguese and French are supported. Tool descriptions ask the assistant to keep cytado's verified sources separate from web results. Listing: starters with concrete examples, translations (es, pt-BR, fr, de).

pl-PL.subtitle: Prawdziwe źródła ze stronami
pl-PL.description: cytado pomaga oprzeć tekst naukowy na prawdziwych, opublikowanych źródłach. Do twierdzenia szuka istniejącej publikacji — autorzy, tytuł, czasopismo, rok — i zwraca numer drukowanej strony z krótkim cytatem, żebyś mógł sam sprawdzić przypis w źródle. Przeszukuje rejestry naukowe (OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, DOAB i inne) oraz korpus pełnych tekstów z prawdziwą paginacją, zbiera źródła do rozdziału i sprawdza, czy pozycje gotowej bibliografii istnieją. Gdy nie znajdzie źródła, które podpiera twierdzenie, mówi to wprost zamiast je proponować. Działa po polsku, angielsku, niemiecku, hiszpańsku, portugalsku i francusku. Wskazówka: zaczynaj wiadomość od @cytado.

es-ES.subtitle: Citas reales con nº de página
es-ES.description: cytado te ayuda a apoyar tu trabajo académico en fuentes reales y publicadas. Para cada afirmación busca una publicación existente — autores, título, revista, año — y devuelve el número de página impreso con una cita breve de esa página, para que puedas comprobar la referencia tú mismo. Busca en registros académicos (OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, DOAB y otros) y en un corpus de textos completos con paginación real, reúne fuentes para un capítulo de tu tesis o TFG y comprueba si las referencias de una bibliografía existen. Si no encuentra una fuente que respalde la afirmación, lo dice en lugar de inventarla. Funciona en español, portugués, inglés, francés, alemán y polaco. Consejo: empieza tu mensaje con @cytado.

pt-BR.subtitle: Citações com número de página
pt-BR.description: O cytado ajuda a fundamentar seu trabalho acadêmico em fontes reais e publicadas. Para cada afirmação, procura uma publicação existente — autores, título, periódico, ano — e devolve o número da página impressa com uma citação curta dessa página, para você conferir a referência. Pesquisa registros acadêmicos (OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, DOAB e outros) e um corpus de textos completos com paginação real, reúne fontes para um capítulo do seu TCC, dissertação ou tese e verifica se as referências de uma bibliografia existem. Quando não encontra uma fonte que sustente a afirmação, diz isso em vez de inventar. Funciona em português, espanhol, inglês, francês, alemão e polonês. Dica: comece sua mensagem com @cytado.

fr-FR.subtitle: Sources réelles et n° de page
fr-FR.description: cytado vous aide à appuyer votre travail universitaire sur des sources réelles et publiées. Pour chaque affirmation, il cherche une publication existante — auteurs, titre, revue, année — et renvoie le numéro de page imprimé avec une courte citation de cette page, pour que vous puissiez vérifier la référence vous-même. Il interroge des registres scientifiques (OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, DOAB, HAL et d’autres) et un corpus de textes intégraux paginés, rassemble des sources pour un chapitre de mémoire et vérifie si les références d’une bibliographie existent. S’il ne trouve aucune source qui appuie l’affirmation, il le dit au lieu d’en inventer une. Fonctionne en français, anglais, espagnol, portugais, allemand et polonais. Astuce : commencez votre message par @cytado.

de-DE.subtitle: Echte Quellen mit Seitenzahlen
de-DE.description: cytado hilft Ihnen, wissenschaftliche Texte auf echte, veröffentlichte Quellen zu stützen. Zu jeder Aussage sucht es eine existierende Publikation — Autoren, Titel, Zeitschrift, Jahr — und liefert die gedruckte Seitenzahl mit einem kurzen Zitat dieser Seite, damit Sie die Fußnote selbst prüfen können. Es durchsucht wissenschaftliche Register (OpenAlex, Crossref, DOAJ, DOAB, DNB u. a.) und ein Volltextkorpus mit echter Paginierung, sammelt Quellen für ein Kapitel und prüft, ob Angaben eines Literaturverzeichnisses existieren. Findet es keine stützende Quelle, sagt es das, statt eine zu erfinden. Funktioniert auf Deutsch, Englisch, Spanisch, Portugiesisch, Französisch und Polnisch. Tipp: Beginnen Sie Ihre Nachricht mit @cytado.
